name: filter-url-state
title: useFilterUrlState
description: Mirrors a filter into the URL as readable, versioned text (?q=status:open&v=1) and follows back/forward and pasted links, with undo intact. Store adapters decouple it from any router: a History API store (replace or push) and a memory store ship, and nuqs or Next.js stores are small recipes. Hydration-safe through useSyncExternalStore and an optional server search; never rewrites a link on load; keeps chips that have no value yet; migrates old links.
